verdicts.quote: when the file has no file-level and no row findings, every row becomes one user in **one atomic unit** (all or none).
the admin sees row number, column and reason for each problem.
`duplicate_in_file` (same canonical email as an earlier row that passed the format check; the **earlier** row is not flagged) → `email_exists` (canonical email already in the User store).
Created users get the **Default role** only. … a file containing a column `role` with value `admin` → `422` `unknown_column`/`role`, no user created.
the import capability (endpoint and page) is available to an Admin only.
verdicts.missing: Whether someone allowed to create one user by hand must qualify separately for bulk import.

verdicts.quote: CSV columns are exactly `email` and `name`, both required; header row required; column order free; header names matched trimmed and case-insensitively. … Unknown columns reject the file (`unknown_column`).
UTF-8 with or without BOM; `,` delimiter; RFC 4180-style quoting (quoted fields may contain commas, doubled quotes and newlines); LF or CRLF line ends
with a fault injected on the store write of row 3 of FX-1 (test-only) → `500` `import_failed`, `ada@` and `grace@` **absent**, count unchanged … does not send mail, SMS or any notification.
Exactly M rows and exactly B bytes are accepted; M+1 rows is `too_many_rows`; B+1 bytes is `file_too_large`.
verdicts.missing: The production row limit M and byte limit B.

verdicts.quote: FX-8 (header only) → `no_data_rows`; FX-9 (0 bytes) → `empty_file` … a 1-row valid file → `201`, 1 created.
A posts FX-1 and gets `201`; A posts FX-1 again → `422`, `email_exists` on rows 2, 3, 4, created 0, count unchanged
the import runs inside one HTTP request: authorize, parse, validate, commit, audit, respond. No queue, worker, polling or job record. … releasing the response shows the outcome.
verdicts.missing: Completion is shown for a synchronous request. If a large file exceeds the request time limit, background processing and its completion notice are left open.

verdicts.quote: creating a user through import does not set a password or token and does not send mail, SMS or any notification.
Created users have **no credential** and **no message is sent**. … users cannot sign in until a separate activation path exists (G-2).
verdicts.missing: The account’s formal activation status and the steps the user takes to obtain access and sign in for the first time.

verdicts.where: State, ownership and lifecycle (Uploaded file bytes); R-7
verdicts.quote: Server, request memory or request-scoped temp storage | Only the handling request; never another admin, never logs … The uploaded file is not retained anywhere after the request ends.
actor id (absent when unauthenticated), UTC timestamp, outcome, number of rows seen, number of file and row findings with their codes, and on success the new user ids.
an aborted upload writes no `created` record and no users … retrying the same file is safe because nothing was written.
verdicts.missing: Whether an admin can cancel after upload while processing is underway, and whether there is a way to retry just the failed rows.

verdicts.quote: a valid M-row file returns `201` within the host's request time limit … visible and announced progress status
verdicts.missing: The maximum file size and the elapsed-time target for processing it. The host request timeout is also unknown.

verdicts.quote: Existing users are never modified.
verdicts.missing: Whether the existing manual single-user creation flow must retain its current behavior.

verdicts.quote: name 100 chars valid, 101 invalid. Email 254 chars valid, 255 invalid. … Result is shown once in the response and not stored: no import history, no downloadable error file.
